title: Semantic revision fingerprint
root_cause: Byte identity alone causes avoidable invalidation while semantic claims can silently drift under superficial equality.
source_requirement: Compute a bounded semantic fingerprint separately from the immutable byte hash.
implementation_steps: Define supported canonicalizers for initial artifact types.
Always retain byte hash alongside semantic hash.
Fail closed to byte revision for unsupported types.
negative_cases: Whitespace-only change alters supported semantic hash.
Behavioral token change leaves semantic hash unchanged.
Unsupported artifact receives guessed semantic hash.
affected_tests: Dependency invalidation and affected proof tests.
evidence_required: Canonicalization version and positive/negative fingerprint vectors.
rollback: Use byte hashes exclusively; never erase original byte identities.
acceptance_criteria: Byte and semantic revisions remain separate and visible.
Unsupported types safely use byte revision.
